title: Manifest des 13 Piliers Mémoire (Vigilum Codex 2.1)
description: Contract defining the 13 canonical pillars of the Source de Vérité under $TESLA_ROOT/memory. The memory parity loop (bin/memory_parite.py) refuses any mission closure unless the 13/13 matrix reports PASS with exit code 0. Adjustable via --manifest for workspace-specific sets; count is strict by default.
